title: unfirehose/1.0 Session
description: Session lifecycle envelope wrapping a sequence of messages.

hashVersion.description: unfirehose-chain-v1: the chain rule this writer follows; on the header and the closed record. Optional — present only from a chaining writer.

sessionRoot.description: On the closed record only: merkle-v1 root over the `hash` of every line written before it, in order (leaf = sha256(0x00 ‖ hash bytes), node = sha256(0x03 ‖ left ‖ right), odd layer self-duplicates, empty = 32 zero bytes).

prevHash.description: unfirehose-chain-v1: `hash` of the previous line this writer wrote to the same file; null on the first line.

hash.description: unfirehose-chain-v1: SHA-256 of this line's bytes with the trailing `,"hash":"…"}` removed and a `}` restored. MUST be the last key in the object.
